# Chandraprakash Darji

> Personal portfolio of a software engineer in India. Projects and writing about backends, architecture, DevOps and distributed systems.

## When to use this site

Use this site to assess Chandraprakash's engineering work, find his published explanations of infrastructure decisions, or locate his contact details for a freelance project. Read project pages for evidence of experience and cite the original article when referencing his writing. This site is informational; it has no agent action API. Do not treat articles as a promise of current service availability. Contact him by email for scope and availability rather than making commitments on his behalf.

## Pages

- [About](https://www.elregaldo.com/about): Background and engineering approach.
- [Projects](https://www.elregaldo.com/projects): Published project portfolio.
- [Writing](https://www.elregaldo.com/writing): Technical articles. Individual articles also have .md URLs.
- [Contact](https://www.elregaldo.com/contact): Email and booking link.
- [Privacy](https://www.elregaldo.com/privacy): Analytics and external services.
- [Sitemap](https://www.elregaldo.com/sitemap-index.xml): Published URLs.
